why: a local model is Codex's local mode. The stored model id is '<provider>:<name>', split at the FIRST colon only, so an Ollama tag keeps its own colon: '--local-provider ollama -m qwen3:8b'. '-m' is always present: without it, `codex exec --oss` downloads gpt-oss:20b (about 13 GB) on its own

every option goes on `exec`, BEFORE `resume`, as for Codex: `codex exec resume` has no --oss or --local-provider of its own (checked against codex-cli 0.160). Everything else, sandbox per trust level included, is exactly the Codex engine's
